title: The front desk offers sample reports that fill the report box
objective: Go to http://127.0.0.1:8010/. Verify that the page shows at least one button that fills in a sample bug report. Click the first of those buttons. Verify that the bug report text box is no longer empty.

answer.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the page shows at least one button that fills in a sample bug report"
answer.summary:
The automated assertion used a definition or locator for a sample-report button that did not match the controls currently shown on the page. Three selectable sample-report choices are visible under “Try a real one:”.
Update the assertion to target the selectable choices under “Try a real one:” using their current accessible role, label, or stable test identifier, then click the first choice and verify the text box changes.
